actions.description: Attach a file to a vector store for indexing
actions.name: add-vector-store-file

vector_store_id.description: The ID of the vector store to attach the file to. Example: "vs_abc123"

file_id.description: The ID of the file to attach. Must be a file that was previously uploaded. Example: "file-abc123"

chunking_strategy.description: Chunking strategy for the file. Use "auto" or "static" with required static config.

max_chunk_size_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens per chunk

chunk_overlap_tokens.description: Number of tokens to overlap between chunks

actions.description: Cancel an OpenAI fine-tuning job.
actions.name: cancel-fine-tuning-job

fine_tuning_job_id.description: The ID of the fine-tuning job to cancel. Example: "ftjob-abc123"

actions.description: Create a batch in OpenAI
actions.name: create-batch

input_file_id.description: The ID of the uploaded file used as batch input. Example: "file-abc123"

endpoint.description: The OpenAI endpoint to call for each request in the batch.

completion_window.description: The time window for batch completion. Only "24h" is currently supported.

metadata.description: Optional key-value metadata to attach to the batch.

output_expires_after.description: Optional expiration policy for output and error files generated by the batch.

anchor.description: The file creation timestamp anchors the expiration policy.

seconds.description: Seconds until output and error files expire, from 1 hour to 30 days.

actions.description: Create a Chat Completions API response for compatibility workflows
actions.name: create-chat-completion

messages.description: Array of messages with role and content

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum number of visible output and reasoning tokens to generate.

max_tokens.description: Deprecated maximum token limit for older models. Use max_completion_tokens for current models.

stream.description: Stream response. Should be false for actions

actions.description: Create embeddings for text inputs.
actions.name: create-embedding

model.description: ID of the model to use. Example: "text-embedding-3-small"

input.description: Input text to embed, encoded as a string or array of strings.

encodingFormat.description: The format to return the embeddings in. Can be "float" or "base64".

dimensions.description: The number of dimensions the resulting output embeddings should have. Only supported in text-embedding-3 and later models.

actions.description: Upload a file to OpenAI. Must be implemented as a proxy script, not an action, due to multipart/form-data requirements.
actions.name: create-file

message.description: Informational message about using the proxy script

actions.description: Generate an image from a prompt.
actions.name: create-image

prompt.description: A text description of the desired image(s). Maximum 32,000 characters for GPT image models.

model.description: A supported GPT Image model ID. Defaults to "gpt-image-1".

n.description: The number of images to generate. Must be between 1 and 10.

size.description: Image dimensions such as "1024x1024", "1536x1024", or "auto". Newer GPT image models support arbitrary WIDTHxHEIGHT values.

quality.description: The image quality. Supported values depend on the selected GPT Image model.

output_compression.description: Compression level from 0 to 100 for JPEG or WebP output.

user.description: A unique identifier representing the end user for abuse monitoring.

actions.description: Classify whether text or images violate OpenAI usage policies
actions.name: create-moderation

text.description: Text to classify. Example: "I want to hurt someone."

url.description: Image URL or base64-encoded data URL to classify.

input.description: A string, array of strings, or array of text and image input objects to classify.

actions.description: Create a model response with text, image, file, or tool inputs
actions.name: create-response

actions.description: Generate speech audio from text.
actions.name: create-speech

input.description: Text to synthesize into speech. Max 4096 characters. Example: "Hello world"

voice.description: Built-in voice name or custom voice ID to use for synthesis. Example: "alloy"

instructions.description: Additional voice instructions for GPT-4o mini TTS models.

content_type.description: MIME type of the audio format.

actions.description: Transcribe audio to text. Use proxy script openai/proxy/transcribe-audio.ts for actual file uploads.
actions.name: create-transcription

filePath.description: Local path to audio file (flac, mp3, mp4, mpeg, mpga, m4a, ogg, wav, webm, max 25MB)

prompt.description: Optional prompt to guide transcription style

actions.description: Create a vector store in OpenAI
actions.name: create-vector-store

name.description: A name for the vector store

file_ids.description: File IDs to attach to the vector store immediately

expires_after.description: Expiration policy for the vector store

days.description: Number of days after last activity when the vector store expires

metadata.description: Metadata with up to 16 key-value pairs

days.description: Number of days after last activity when the vector store expires

actions.description: Delete a stored OpenAI response
actions.name: delete-response

response_id.description: The ID of the response to delete. Example: "resp_abc123"

actions.description: Remove a file from a vector store (does not delete the underlying file object)
actions.name: delete-vector-store-file

vector_store_id.description: The ID of the vector store. Example: "vs_abc123"

file_id.description: The ID of the file to remove from the vector store. Example: "file-abc123"

actions.description: Delete a vector store from OpenAI
actions.name: delete-vector-store

vector_store_id.description: The ID of the vector store to delete. Example: "vs_abc123"

id.description: The ID of the deleted vector store

deleted.description: Whether the vector store was successfully deleted

actions.description: Retrieve a single batch from OpenAI
actions.name: get-batch

batch_id.description: The ID of the batch to retrieve. Example: "batch_abc123"

actions.description: Retrieve a single file metadata from OpenAI
actions.name: get-file

file_id.description: The ID of the file to retrieve. Example: "file-123"

actions.description: Retrieve a single model from OpenAI.
actions.name: get-model

actions.description: Retrieve a stored OpenAI response by ID.
actions.name: get-response

response_id.description: The ID of the response to retrieve. Must start with "resp_". Example: "resp_abc123"

id.description: The unique identifier of the response.

model.description: The model used to generate the response.

output.description: Array of output items from the response.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the response was created.

actions.description: Retrieve a single file attached to a vector store.
actions.name: get-vector-store-file

vector_store_id.description: The ID of the vector store. Example: "vs_6a0cb67e028081918ccec0ba7278ffd0"

file_id.description: The ID of the file. Example: "file_abc123"

actions.description: Retrieve a single vector store from OpenAI
actions.name: get-vector-store

vector_store_id.description: The ID of the vector store to retrieve. Example: "vs_abc123"

actions.description: List batches from OpenAI
actions.name: list-batches

after.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list.

actions.description: List files from OpenAI
actions.name: list-files

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response (last_id). Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Number of files to return (1-10000, default 10000).

actions.description: List fine-tuning jobs from OpenAI
actions.name: list-fine-tuning-jobs

after.description: Pagination cursor (job ID) from the previous response. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Number of jobs to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

next_cursor.description: Use as the "after" parameter for the next page of results

actions.description: List all models available to the authenticated organization
actions.name: list-models

actions.description: List files attached to a vector store
actions.name: list-vector-store-files

vector_store_id.description: The ID of the vector store to list files from. Example: "vs_abc123"

after.description: Cursor for pagination. The ID of the file to start after.

limit.description: Number of files to return (1-100, default 20).

actions.description: List vector stores from OpenAI.
actions.name: list-vector-stores

after.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the `last_id` from the previous response to get the next page.

limit.description: Number of vector stores to return. Default: 20, Max: 100.

order.description: Sort order by created_at. Options: asc, desc. Default: desc.

actions.description: Search a vector store for semantically matching content chunks
actions.name: search-vector-store

actions.description: Update a vector store in OpenAI
actions.name: update-vector-store
